newsitem.title: UK: UK B/socs April net new approvals s/a 3.314 mln.
newsitem.headline: UK B/socs April net new approvals s/a 3.314 mln.

text.p: The British Building Societies Association (BSA) released the following, seasonally adjusted, data on lending:-
MORTGAGE ADVANCES AND NEW APPROVALS TO LEND (in 1000s)
NOTES - approval = borrower accepts offer of advance; advance = actual loan, on average some 10 wks after commitment; advances tend to reflect new approvals made 2 or 3 mths ago.
BSA director-general Adrian Coles said the figures represented further good news for the housing market, given that both Alliance and Leicester and National and Provincial had left the sector.
"These figures indicate that the housing market is continuing its steady recovery," he said.

The figures suggested that recovery in the housing market was not affected by any uncertainty caused by the May 1 election. "The traditional spring pick-up in house buying appears to be in full swing," Coles said.
However, the upturn remained patchy in some areas, with London and the south-east seeing the best of the recovery.

The net inflow of 608 million stg showed savers continued to find building society products attractive, "particularly now that the seasonal outflow caused by the PEP (personal equity plan) deadline in March is past and the equity market is looking expensive."
